decision: ship the real harness gaps, drop stale or out-of-scope bullets
why: done means empty CONTRIBUTING list plus a strictly better harness, not a list emptied by dropping everything

decision: missing op and _skip on operations become guiding lint messages
why: TypeError was the CONTRIBUTING crash; checkSpec now names the missing block and does not recompute goldens on an invalid spec

decision: assert BLOCKS >= 6 next to the constant
why: ciRank returns -1 below 6 and conservativePct then reports 0, which looks like no regressions

decision: lintSpecsDir rejects token-codec ids such as url-codec
why: the historical bug is a single token plus -codec, not every id that ends with -codec

decision: unrepresentable example output fails the check instead of becoming an error golden
why: a passing op was being pinned as an error string the harness knew was a serializer failure

decision: valueToCode emits new Uint8Array and uint8array.yaml exists
why: S.uint8Array could not be specced before

decision: serialize quotes tabs and escapes DEL/C1 as u00xx
why: ipv4 had a raw tab, uri-template had raw DEL and C1; PyYAML rejects those

decision: sparse jsonSchema.targets for draft-2020-12 and openapi-3.0
why: only when the document minus dollar-schema differs from the default emit; string.yaml stays two fields
result: VERIFIED jsonstring-object has contentSchema, string.yaml has no targets

decision: example.bench true splits a run target out of its aggregate
why: union-large-planner cheap member was invisible in the accept batch

decision: recursive create+compile skip

decision: fromJSONSchema instantiations budget

decision: URL href vs input source
why: S.url uses new URL; the golden should pin WHATWG canonicalization; engines pin is the lock

decision: json-target op dimension

decision: ReScript-only res dimension

decision: async encode dimension
